title: CS2 World Bundle material table (materials.json)
description: A flat object keyed by materialId. A mesh primitive in meshes/*.glb references a material by putting the materialId in the glTF material's 'name'.

materialId.description: Sanitised material name: ASCII alphanumerics, dot, underscore and hyphen; must start with an alphanumeric.

texRef.description: Bundle-root-relative POSIX path into the texture directory, e.g. "textures/<sha256>.png".

material.description: A CS2 PBR material reduced to a small documented set. Every map is optional; a consumer substitutes its own default for anything absent.

normal.description: Tangent-space normal map. Linear, OpenGL convention (+Y up).

mask.description: CS2 control/MADS map. Linear. Channel semantics are fixed: R=metallic, G=ambient occlusion, B=detail//emissive mask, A=smoothness (roughness = 1 - A).

colorMask.description: CS2 _ControlMask. Linear. R, G and B select, per texel, which of the three colour channels of the mesh's colors.json palette entry applies there; A is snow coverage (white = no snow). Without this map the palette in colors.json cannot be applied to anything.

tint.description: Multiplied into baseColor. Linear RGBA in 0..1. Omitted means [1,1,1,1].

emissiveFactor.description: Multiplied into emissive. Linear RGB in 0..1.

flags.description: Producer hints a consumer may act on or ignore. Known values in schema 2: 'foliage' (wind-animated / alpha-tested vegetation), 'decal' (projected surface, no thickness), 'glass', 'emissiveWindows' (night-lit windows driven by the emissive map), 'terrainBlend' (blends into the ground surface), 'colorVariation' (per-instance tint applied by the game).
